title: Nice Nutty Jamaican Shrimp Skewers
description: A quick and flavorful Jamaican dish featuring shrimp, light rum, and a hint of nuttiness, grilled to perfection on a robata grill. This dish is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly and can be prepared in no time.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, soy sauce, brown sugar, grated ginger, and light rum.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Brush the skewers with the remaining marinade and sprinkle with chopped pecans and scallions.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Flambe the skewers with a little extra light rum, if desired.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional scallions and pecans if desired.
